ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, it is the graph of the linear function $y=mx+n$. What is the solution set of the inequality $mx+n>0$ with respect to $x$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} From the graph, we know: \\
The solution set of the inequality $mx+n>0$ with respect to $x$ is: $x>-1$. \\
Thus, the answer is: $\boxed{x>-1}$.
